Resolves #20152

When a Workstation popup is closed after the main window reloaded, `NativeVesselTransaction.releaseWorkspace` now checks `!WindowManager.get(route.ownerWindowId)` before calling `Neo.Main.windowNativeIsClosed`, returning the popup's workspace at once (`23 ms`) instead of catching the dead-port rejection as `null` and waiting out the 20 s reconnect lease (`20,035 ms`).

Change class (`pull-request-workflow.md §3.1`): `restoration` (`fix`). `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; `reusable-pr-baseline.yml` jobs run in CI.

Evidence: L3 (local Chrome + Playwright `neuralLink` Workstation measurement and `DockNativeVesselTransaction.spec.mjs` unit suite) → L3 required (`AC-1`, `AC-2`). No residuals.

Micro-review eligible: contained — 2-line departed-opener guard in `NativeVesselTransaction.releaseWorkspace` matching `#20149`'s `holdReleasedVessel` rule, plus its unit arm in `DockNativeVesselTransaction.spec.mjs`.

| AC-2 If confirmed: a unit arm in `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockNativeVesselTransaction.spec.mjs`; a departed opener returns the workspace without waiting for the lease, and the live-opener arms stay green | CI: `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockNativeVesselTransaction.spec.mjs` › `#20152 a workspace whose opener departed returns at once without waiting for the lease` (`40/40` green) |

## Test Evidence
- **Live Workstation Measurement (`NEO_NL_PORT=18081`):** Popped out `'commits'`, reloaded the main window (`ac058025-c477-41aa-84d6-16714f682032` → `1b3b3f20-c501-4b9a-b0c4-3698c4550631`), and closed the popup (`popup.close({runBeforeUnload: true})`). On unpatched `dev`, `commits` was still absent at `+3 s` and returned at `20,035 ms`. With `!WindowManager.get(route.ownerWindowId)` in `releaseWorkspace`, the popup disconnect at `20:24:55.049Z` returned the workspace at `20:24:55.072Z` (`23 ms`).
- **Mutation / Falsification:** In `#20152 a workspace whose opener departed returns at once without waiting for the lease`, `owner.answers.observe` rejects with `Error('no live port for departed opener')` (matching `worker.Base#promiseMessage` for an unregistered `windowId`). Without `!WindowManager.get(route.ownerWindowId)`, `.catch(() => null)` resolves `observed` to `null` and `owner.release()` returns `{retained: true, awaitingClosure: true}`, failing the test.
- **Local Unit Suite:** `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockNativeVesselTransaction.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockWorkspace.spec.mjs` (`198/198` passed).
